main_text.head: Interpretatio.
main_text.p: Anistis casibus.) In istis casibus, corrigendum est sine dubio.
Ex eo concipiatur. ) Deinde is adultus uxorem ducat, quae ex eo concipiat.
Isq; uiuo patre, deinde auo.) Nemo, nisi talpa caecior, non uidet, corrigendum esse, ISQVE MORTUO PATRE. Vult enim patrem prius decedere, ne successione testamentum rumpatur.
Poterit heres institui.) Id est, An illa institutio nepotis possit ad pronepotem pertinere.

page.notes: Printed "*fic" in the left margin is a correction mark "*sic"; the text word "et*fi" is written "et{*}si" with the mark placed as printed. Left-margin "*ado- / ptatus." is the hyphenated margin note "*adoptatus." Long s read as f throughout (e.g. "fet", "effet", "fuus") and transcribed as s. Running head is faint and not reliably legible. Lead-in words in italic are Latin abbreviations and read as printed (e.g. "Isq;" = Isque, "auo" = avo). The final line "institu-" continues onto the next page. Two possible printing errors: "Aniftis" and "fi" read with long s uncertain.
